test_jit_speed_benchmark: test the JIT speed benchmark tool by running jit_speed_benchmark.main with a traced model and input dimensions
create_save_model: create a traced or scripted TorchScript model and save it to a directory using model_utils
create_test_data: create a list of torch tensors with shape 1x3x4x4 for use as model input data
review_Model_class: review the Model nn.Module subclass that adds 1.0 to its input tensor in the forward pass
review_ModelDict_class: review the ModelDict nn.Module subclass that returns a dictionary of two output tensors from two inputs
